title: 在 clash 里加入了一点 dae 的成分
content: The author integrated eBPF-based transparent proxying from dae into their forked Rust proxy clash-rs and OpenWrt plugin nikki-rs. This bypasses traditional iptables/nftables forwarding by using kernel hooks to automatically intercept and route traffic. Direct connections are dynamically offloaded to eBPF maps after DNS-based routing decisions, solving limitations of static IP-based bypass rules. The feature requires compatible Linux kernel modules and is configurable via YAML settings for interfaces, ports, DSCP/fwmark bypasses, and source/target filtering rules.

Inside Cursor: The Anatomy of a Generational Startup
content: a16z partners analyze Cursor's unconventional path in the competitive AI coding market. The startup prioritized human-AI interface over building its own foundation model, created a standalone IDE instead of a VS Code plugin, and maintained strict focus by refusing distractions. Cursor evolved from IDE to AI agent platform, willingly cannibalizing earlier products as capabilities advanced. The company's culture—obsessive product focus, selective hiring, and calm competitive posture against Microsoft and Anthropic—offers lessons for founders on defying conventional startup wisdom.

title: 不想写代码，但想要集成一个登录页面？ Sa-Token-Quick-Login 帮你实现！
content: Sa-Token-Quick-Login is a zero-code Java plugin that adds login authentication to systems quickly. It targets simple internal tools (like server monitoring dashboards) where a basic login page is needed without custom development. Users add two dependencies to a Spring Boot project, and the plugin automatically intercepts unauthenticated requests to a default login page. Configuration options include custom credentials, page title, path inclusion/exclusion, and static resource serving. The plugin can also run as a standalone JAR to deploy static websites with optional authentication. It is not suitable for projects requiring customized login interfaces.

title: Anthropic 据传本周发布 Opus 5.1 模型

The company may also launch a next-generation flagship model, possibly Mythos or Fable 5.1, within two weeks. Meanwhile, OpenAI has allegedly completed pre-training its 10-trillion-parameter Bel model, intended as the foundation for its upcoming Astra system. title: 智谱发布并开源多模态模型 GLM-5.3-Flash：对标 DeepSeek，由 10 万国产卡支持
content: Zhipu released and open-sourced GLM-5.3-Flash, a 320B-parameter multimodal model. It matches Claude Opus 4.8's performance on the AA intelligence index at roughly 1/40 the price. The model employs a novel sparse-linear attention hybrid architecture, reducing attention computation by 3x and KV cache by 4.4x versus its predecessor. Powered by 100,000 domestic Chinese chips, it achieves NVIDIA GPU-level hardware efficiency through proprietary optimizations. The model is globally available via API and multiple platforms.

title: 阿里千问发布 Qwen3.8-Flash 并开源
content: Alibaba's Tongyi Qianwen team released Qwen3.8-Flash, a multimodal MoE model, and open-sourced Qwen3.8-Flash-Next weights, a prototype of the upcoming Qwen4 series. The 125B parameter model activates 6B parameters per token, supports 262,144 tokens context (extendable to 1M), and reduces training costs to one-ninth of Qwen3.7-Plus. It achieved top results in 8 of 14 benchmarks, with stronger coding and office capabilities. Weights are available on Hugging Face and ModelScope in FP8 quantized versions, with API access coming to the Qianwen AI platform.

Evaluated across four cohorts and seven clinical tasks—including diabetes risk, insulin resistance, and beta-cell dysfunction—GlucoFM achieved 5.8 percentage points higher average PR-AUC than the best baseline.
